title: CS3001 Data Structures — Mid Semester Examination

key_points: A stack is a last in first out LIFO structure
Push and pop operations run in constant time
Stack overflow occurs when pushing onto a full array stack
negative_conditions: Describes a stack as first in first out FIFO

partial_credit_rules.condition: Names push and pop without explaining order

key_points: Binary search tree left subtree keys are smaller than the node key
Inorder traversal of a binary search tree gives sorted order
Search takes logarithmic time when the tree is balanced
Hash collisions happen when two keys map to the same bucket
Separate chaining stores colliding keys in a linked list
Open addressing probes for the next free slot

partial_credit_rules.condition: Mentions collisions but no resolution strategy

key_points: Breadth first search uses a queue and visits level by level
Depth first search uses a stack or recursion
Both traversals run in linear time in vertices plus edges
